messages:
Ana: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window tonight 00:30–01:30 UTC for a graceful IO-throttle + tenant rotation in us-west2 (rack A3). Thermal hotspot observed; we want to avoid sudden preempts. Targeting shared pools only, dedicated pools excluded.

Ana: Plan in short: cordon a small cohort, rotate tenants off the cohort, apply IO throttle to avoid IO storms, then reboot GPUs gracefully if needed, uncordon after KV-cache seeding backfill. Expect intermittent <2% p99 latency bumps; no full customer-facing downtime planned.

Ana: Action steps (will run from the ops runway job):
```
# cordon cohort
./infra cordon --region us-west2 --rack A3 --cohort 7 --reason "thermal mitigation"
# rotate tenants in batches of 8
./ops rotate-tenants --pool shared-saturn --batch-size 8 --concurrency 2
# apply IO throttle to cohort
curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"A3-7","io_pct":50}'
```

Sam: Do we have enough spare capacity to accept those tenant rotations without queueing? what's expected drop in throughput?

Leah: We measured baseline for us-west2-shared: ~75% GPU utilization. We can absorb rotation of ~6 GPUs concurrently before queueing. If we run batches of 8 with concurrency 2 (as Ana suggested) we should be OK if we stagger by 8m.

Mike: Re: dedicated pools — confirm those are excluded. Last thing we want is to move enterprise dedicated tenants.

Ana: Confirmed — dedicated pools (tag: dedicated-*) are excluded. Rotation targets only pools: shared-saturn, shared-zephyr, burst-interruptible. We'll include the exclusion flag in the job.

Sam: Can we bias rotation to interactive tenants last? background training jobs can be preempted first. That reduces user-facing impact.

Leah: Good call. Add priority: background > batch > interactive. We'll generate a tenant-priority list from the scheduler.

Mike: What's the rollback plan if p99 > 10% or errors spike?

Ana: Rollback steps: pause rotation, uncordon any nodes we moved off, and revert throttle. Quick commands: 
```
# pause the ops job
./ops job pause JOB-6150004243
# uncordon cohort
./infra uncordon --region us-west2 --rack A3 --cohort 7
# remove throttle
curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"A3-7","io_pct":0}'
```
I'll also open a rollback ticket and tag @oncall.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance job created: JOB-6150004243-IO-ROTATE (starts 6150004200, window 60m). Watch ops dashboard for progress. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Any cost impact from burst backfills? We should put a note for finance.

Leah: Small bump expected: we estimate ~3% extra GPU-hours for the window due to overlap/backfill — roughly $3k–$5k regional impact depending on actual retries. Will log exact estimate post-run.

Mike: I'll own the canary and will watch p99 and GPU temperature telemetry. If temp drift persists after two cohorts, we escalate to hardware team.

Ana: Thanks — I'll post a short status update to #incidents at start, mid, and end of window. Ping me directly if you see p99 > 2% or error spike > 1%.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: deploy lock enabled for us-west2 cohorts from 00:20–01:40 UTC.

Sam: ack. Will throttle client-side retries on the SDK to spread load during rotation.

Ana: Final note — tenants with regulatory tags and dedicated reservations are exempt. If you have any last-minute runbook asks, drop them now. Otherwise we start the run at 00:30 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
